name: Floodlight Derby
description: A night football derby that plays itself under stadium floodlights. Two fictional teams pass, dribble, tackle, cross and shoot in a simulated match, keepers dive to save, shots ring off the post, goals bulge the net and set off flares and phone flashes in the packed stands, while a broadcast camera follows the ball and a scoreboard keeps time. Code-drawn, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
